entry.title: Launching on Product Hunt Today - Calisthenics Rep Tracker
entry.summary: I built Nickels & Dimes, a calisthenics rep tracker with public/private clubs and PR tracking, and it's live on Product Hunt today. I was logging reps in my Notes app like an animal. Every calisthenics tracker I found was either bloated with features I didn't need or built for weightlifting, not bodyweight work. So I built the thing I actually wanted to use. What it does: log push-ups, pull-ups, dips, whatever bodyweight movement you're doing, and it tracks your PRs automatically. Start a club with friends and compete on a leaderboard that resets monthly. Nothing fancy, just the numbers that actually matter when you're trying to get better. Solo project, no team. Stack is Next.js, Supabase for auth and Postgres, Prisma as the ORM, Tailwind, deployed on Vercel. I used Claude Code as my execution partner for the whole build, but every product, design, and UX call was mine. It let me move fast without hand writing every line myself, which mattered a lot doing this alone. It's been in daily use with my own friend group for a while now. That's the only reason I trust it enough to put in front of strangers. nickelsanddimes.app if you want to poke around, or check out the Product Hunt launch if you want to leave a comment or upvote. Happy to answer anything about the build.
